answer: At each epoch dawn, every identity loses 5% of its reputation unless a key-signed work entry is recorded in the wharf registry that epoch; the registry is public. The kth fake costs as much as the first: one distinct task per epoch at 30 credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 30,000 credits every epoch, with no discount and no task reuse. At its nadir of 40 points an identity is suspended and its 60-credit bond stays frozen. History rental fails: a rented record cannot sign wharf entries under the renter's key, so it still decays to nadir. One honest agent needs one task per epoch.
